incidents.name: MasterChef public setTrustedForwarder()
incidents.notes: MasterChef.setTrustedForwarder() is public, so the attacker became the trusted forwarder and spoofed _msgSender() through the calldata suffix to set pool 0's deposit fee to 100% and route the fee into the CRSS/WBNB pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x70873211CB64c1D4EC027Ea63a399A7D07c4085B created 2022-01-11T19:27:02Z by 0x0590f20a7f1b6799979d2d59d10242e1081d8d9c, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc49f2938327aa2cdc3f2f89ed17b54b3671f05de; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 4.16 WBNB x $596.9/BNB at the incident timestamp 1746523319 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,483.
